summary: Only synthetic, author-written data is used. No real citizen messages are included or used for training/evaluation.

corpora.origin: 75 templates (RU 38, KK 37) written by the R08 agent; expanded deterministically by corpus.generate_from_templates(seed=20261006, per_template=30)
corpora.llm_note: Text was written by an AI coding agent (Claude) during this session; it is LLM-authored synthetic text, not collected data.
corpora.kazakh_quality: written by a non-native author; not reviewed by a native Kazakh speaker
corpora.labels: inherited from template by the same author (not independent annotation)
corpora.personal_data: none; place names are generic Astana street/district names, house numbers are invented

corpora.origin: 83 individually written informal / borderline / short / mixed-language / no-Kazakh-letter messages by the R08 agent
corpora.labels: single author, with ambiguous flag and note; not an independent expert assessment
corpora.usage: never used for training; split between validation (threshold selection) and test

real_data_audit.result: No permitted, de-identified real corpus of Astana/Kazakhstan civic messages with topic labels was available to this session.

checked.result: NOT USED. Web search result (egov.kz article) states appeals were moved to E-Otinish in April 2023 and closed from public access; scraping or leaked exports are excluded by policy. Not verified by direct fetch.
not used; search did not surface a dataset of appeal TEXTS with topic labels; aggregates of appeals, if any, are not suitable for text training. Not exhaustively checked.

checked.source: KazSAnDRA (arXiv 2403.19335, CC BY 4.0) and other open Kazakh corpora
checked.result: not used: sentiment/reviews domain, no civic topic labels; possible future use only for language-robustness checks with attribution

processing.normalisation: NFC, casefold, Latin homoglyph -> Cyrillic inside Cyrillic-majority words, ё->е; Kazakh letters preserved
processing.near_duplicates: char-5 shingle Jaccard >= 0.8 clustered and kept in one split (cross-group pairs: 0)
